about: The 32 s motion-graphics showreel from the PRD prototype (1920x1080). The video is not in git; set VIDEO_DIGEST_SHOWREEL. Questions have no evidence spans, so accuracy needs --live.

reference.source: prototype qa_bench, 3 runs, claude-sonnet-5-5, judge claude-haiku-5-5

questions.question: What is the name of the product being advertised?
What descriptor appears under the logo the first time it is shown?
Complete the opening line: 'Your ATS tracks ___.'
According to the video, what is the one thing an ATS doesn't do?
How many ATS platforms does it claim to work with?
Name three of the ATS platforms shown.
questions.answer: Any three of: Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, BambooHR, Bullhorn, Personio, Jobvite, Comeet, JazzHR, Workable, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Breezy, iCIMS, Pinpoint, SmartRecruiters, Rippling.

questions.question: In the live monitoring view, at which funnel stage is a drop-off flagged, and how big is it?
questions.answer: At the Phone Screen stage, a 42% drop-off.

questions.question: What question is typed into the 'Ask your data' box?
questions.answer: Why did time-to-hire increase this quarter?

questions.question: The video says something is no longer needed. What?
How many recipients or groups receive the weekly performance report?
Which comes first: the 'Recommendations' section or the 'Weekly Performance Report'?
At about what time (in seconds) does the full-screen logo first appear?
What is the closing tagline?
questions.answer: Run recruiting on intelligence. Not intuition.

questions.question: What is the call to action at the very end?
Is any price or pricing plan shown in the video? Answer yes or no.
